grade_notes.staged: measured on the cases the gate lists (kakashi, sasuke, taikoubou, eve, muhyo, raoh, kenshin, jotaro, yoh, yusuke); the arithmetic is arm9 0x020817E8-0x02081978. Full HP band (x1), no crit, neutral weight, facing side of the sign rule
grade_notes.impulse: measured on the rest-start cases the gate lists; ov6 0x0215AF98-0x0215AFC4 and the entry table; null when the type's entry does not add obj+0x10A/+0x10C
grade_notes.px: impulse / 256, px per frame, before drag and gravity
grade_notes.first_frame_air: inferred: victim velocity one integrator pass after the hit, starting at rest in the air: drag 32/256 (x) and 8/256 (y), gravity 41, cap 128 << 8 as physics.md 6.1 measured (element +0x3C/+0x3D/+0x3E, [r3+0x2C]), not read here
grade_notes.first_frame_ground: as first_frame_air, but a downward vy becomes 0 on a standing victim. One downward case is measured (Kakashi air B, na_b_04 rec 11: the gate reads the capture, (-560, 0)); every other row is inferred from that rule. The floor contact at arm9 0x0207ECE4-0x0207ECF4 zeroing a positive +0x26 is the inferred cause
grade_notes.sign: facing: the attacker's facing picks the screen sign (positive kbX pushes away); relative: the side the hitting element is on picks it (arm9 0x0208189C-0x020818E4)
grade_notes.zero: inferred: the propMask bit that sets element +0x14 bit 0x01000000 zeroes both components at arm9 0x0208186C; not seen live
grade_notes.override: lead: element +0x14 bit 0x04000000 plus victim element +0x14 & 0x700 replaces the pair with (0x300, -0x500); what sets the victim bits is not traced; not seen live
grade_notes.band: type 6 only: staged at the four HP-band multipliers (arm9 0x0209FB64); measured on Kenshin up X and X
grade_notes.damage: measured byte (+4, the base damage the damage formula reads at 0x02082428); the hit's real damage also goes through nature, abilities and resistances
grade_notes.move_records: records in the fighter anim's CollisionType tracks, first key order; a record listed may never land (checked only where the gate joins one: Kakashi Y lists three and all three land); a move whose anim has none hits from a spawned object
grade_notes.installs: measured: the per-frame handler each reaction entry stores to obj+0xFC (read statically); the live obj+0xFC values in physics.md (0x0215B720, 0x0215B910, 0x0215BAB8, and 0x0215B818 for reaction 4) are these words
